teaser.en: Don't burn it: its smoke is said to give you sores in the nose, which is exactly what its name means.
teaser.sw: Usiuchome: inasemekana moshi wake huleta vidonda puani, na hiyo ndiyo hasa maana ya jina lake.
teaser.dg: Usiutsome: nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani, na hiyo ndiyo mana ya dzinare.

summary.en: *Mpamapama* is a coastal forest tree with rough leaves and fleshy fruits. It is avoided as firewood because its smoke is said to cause sores in the nose.
summary.sw: *Mpamapama* ni mti wa misitu ya pwani wenye majani yanayokwaruza na matunda yenye nyama. Huepukwa kama kuni kwa sababu inasemekana moshi wake husababisha vidonda puani.
summary.dg: *Mpamapama* ni muhi wa matsaka ga pwani wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda genye nyama. Atu nkuhepa kuutsoma dza kuni kpwa sababu nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani.

about.en: *Mpamapama* is a tree with rough leaves and fleshy fruits. It is a *Cordia*, a genus known for sandpapery leaves and soft, often sticky fruit.
about.sw: *Mpamapama* ni mti wenye majani yanayokwaruza na matunda yenye nyama. Ni *Cordia*, jenasi inayojulikana kwa majani yanayokwaruza kama msasa na matunda laini ambayo mara nyingi yananata.
about.dg: *Mpamapama* ni muhi wenye makodza ganayokaraza na matunda genye nyama. Ni *Cordia*, jenasi inayomanyikana kpwa makodza ganayokaraza dza msasa, na matunda malaini ambago mara nyinji ganayonyata.

uses.en: *Mpamapama* is known mainly for what it is not used for: people avoid burning it as firewood.
uses.sw: *Mpamapama* unajulikana zaidi kwa kile usichotumiwa: watu huepuka kuuchoma kama kuni.
uses.dg: *Mpamapama* unamanyikana zaidi kpwa chitu ambacho tauhumirwa: atu nkuhepa kuutsoma dza kuni.

culture.en: The name, according to Pakia, means 'nose wounds', because its smoke is said to cause sores in the nose. The name carries a warning to anyone gathering firewood.
culture.sw: Kwa mujibu wa Pakia, jina hili linamaanisha 'vidonda vya pua', kwa sababu inasemekana moshi wake husababisha vidonda puani. Jina hilo ni onyo kwa yeyote anayetafuta kuni.
culture.dg: Pakia anaandika kukala dzina hiri rina mana ya 'vironda vya pula', kpwa sababu nkugombwa mosi wa muhi uhu unalavya vironda pulani. Dzina hiri rinaonya chila mutu anayehendza kuni.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *mpamapama*, 'nose wounds'. No Swahili or English name is recorded; botanists know it as *Cordia goetzei*.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi jina la Kidigo *mpamapama*, 'vidonda vya pua'. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Cordia goetzei*.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *mpamapama*, 'vironda vya pula'. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anauiha *Cordia goetzei*.

reason.en: Another Cordia, also with a vivid name
reason.sw: Cordia mwingine, pia mwenye jina la kuvutia
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina wa *Cordia*, nao piya una dzina ra ajabu

reason.en: Also named for a property of its wood
reason.sw: Pia umepewa jina kutokana na sifa ya mbao zake
reason.dg: Nao piya dzinare rinakula kpwa tabiya ya nyama za muhi
